name: Heat stone
slug: A warming stone that keeps its bearer warm, bought from Nyx Cage in Agenheim.
description: A heat stone, also called a warming stone, a fire stone, or a hot rock, keeps its bearer warm. It is not a primal stone. Further fire magic is theoretically possible, but without proper containment the stone would implode immediately.

log.summary: The party bought heat stones in Agenheim from Nyx Cage the Ice Mage because it was cold. A discount was offered for stealing a peace treaty in Helheim; they paid without doing the job. Walker still has his, and Plymouth confirms it does what it is supposed to. Walker will not attempt further fire magic. Gerk treats his as a hot rock he puts in his pants.
